optimized_sql:
WITH hd AS (
    SELECT household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE household_demographics.hd_dep_count = 0
),
td AS (
    SELECT time_dim.t_time_sk
    FROM time_dim
    WHERE time_dim.t_hour = 8 AND time_dim.t_minute >= 30
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM hd
JOIN store_sales ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN td ON store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk AND store.s_store_name = 'ese'
ORDER BY COUNT(*)
LIMIT 100
